name: xros
description: Executable research operating system. Four commands: compile a long-horizon investigation into a verifiable methodology spec, sharpen an un-checkable question into a falsifiable claim with its best-available check, run the Tier-A/B multi-agent engine gated on a real oracle, or reason through a no-oracle (Tier-C) claim with premises, pre-mortem, and dated tripwires. Refuses to claim a verified result without a mechanical check.
